concept.title: ADI OtoSense™ web and mobile applications
concept.shortdesc: The ADI OtoSense™ SMS application allows you to monitor and manage the health of motors

conbody.p: The ADI OtoSense™ SMS application allows you to monitor and manage the health of motors fitted with SMS devices. It has a user-friendly interface that:

ul.li: provides a snapshot of the health of motors located across multiple locations.
indicates when a motor is in good working condition, when a fault is detected, and when a motor needs maintenance.
identifies the exact motor component that needs repair and suggests a course of action.

conbody.p: The application also supports analysis of the raw data collected by the SMS device. Motor maintenance experts can visualize the present and historical data of various motor parameters to help them understand a motor’s health and predict future problems.

This application is available for both web-based and mobile platforms. The SMS mobile application offers most of the same functionality and user interface as the web-based application. With the mobile app, you can also:

ul.li: receive push notifications about changes in motor status
